name: MMC D1 cluster WHSF, D30 and Dana fields, offshore Sarawak
description: Approximately 45 m water depth; substructure acts as drilling template with 36-inch conductors driven and grouted into four 40-inch legs doubling as structural piles; D30 accommodates at least eight wells, Dana at least five; JOC partners Petronas Carigali, Pertamina and Petrovietnam; 24-inch internal conductors.
